fields.h1: Build Patient Intake Automation That Routes Only the Exceptions
fields.hero_description: Build patient intake automation that sends intake forms at booking, chases unfinished ones, and flags answers that need a person.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Into an Intake Workflow
fields.features_subheading: The app sends and chases every intake on its own and stops for a person only when an answer needs one.
fields.feature_1:
An intake link with every booking

A new appointment in your scheduling system starts the intake, and the app emails the patient a link that same minute. A new patient and a returning one can get different forms.
fields.feature_2:
Reminders that end in a call list

Choose when an unfinished intake gets a reminder email and when it moves to a person instead. Open intakes land on a front desk list sorted by visit time, with phone numbers.
fields.feature_3:
Card photos read into plan fields

Patients photograph the front and back of their insurance card, and AI turns each photo into fields. A value read with low confidence goes to a person before the record is saved.
fields.feature_4:
Answers routed to one named person

Write a rule for any answer staff must act on, such as an allergy or a missing referral. The app messages that person in Slack, by email, or in the app, and logs who was told.
fields.feature_5:
A live board of tomorrow's arrivals

The dashboard lists tomorrow's patients with each intake marked finished, open, or held, and it updates as answers come in. Every answer is saved to a database you own.
fields.feature_6:
The intake app's code, in your GitHub

Export the full code of the intake app to your GitHub repository on paid plans. A developer can host it on your own servers and connect it to new software as the practice adds it.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Intake Exceptions a Person Should See
fields.tab_content_1:
By 4 p.m. Wednesday, 3 open intakes reach the front desk

Brindlewood Dermatology has 24 new patients booked for Thursday. Each one got an intake link by email at booking, and anyone unfinished got a reminder 2 days before the visit. By 4 p.m. Wednesday, 21 intakes are complete. The app sends the 3 still open to Ilsabet Aldecoa, the front desk lead, as a call list.
fields.tab_content_2:
Billing checks a member ID that is one digit off

Cormac Tennant photographs both sides of his insurance card for a Monday knee consult at Coldharbor Orthopedics. AI reads the member ID from the front. He typed QX4471902, but the card reads QX4471962. The app holds the intake for Odhran Fairclough, the billing coordinator.
fields.tab_content_3:
Before Tuesday, a latex allergy reaches the surgical assistant

Saoirse Ebbesen is booked for a tooth extraction at Hollins Creek Oral Surgery on Tuesday at 8:00 a.m. On Sunday at 7:12 p.m., she answers yes to the latex allergy question. The app sends a direct message to Ysella Quellet, Tuesday's surgical assistant, and flags latex on the day sheet.
fields.tab_content_4:
Two possible duplicates stay out of the patient records

Pallas Ridge Sleep Clinic sends each finished intake to its scheduling system through its API. On Monday, 41 intakes finish, and 39 become new patient records. The other 2 share a last name and date of birth with an existing patient, and wait in a merge queue for Fenella Sarvari, the records lead.

fields.howto_description: Seven steps to map your intake, give every exception an owner, and build patient intake automation with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write down how intake runs today
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Pick the questions per visit type
fields.howto_step_1_des: List every step from the booking call to the patient in the exam room: who sends the forms, how they come back, who types them into the scheduling system, and who checks insurance. Mark each step where a staff member waits on a patient.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Split the questions every new patient answers from the ones only one visit type needs, such as a procedure consent. Cut any question nobody on staff reads before the visit. Keep the intake short enough to finish on a phone in one sitting.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Pick two times for each visit type: the day an unfinished intake gets its reminder, and the hour the front desk takes over. Work back from the visit and leave a full afternoon to call patients who still have not finished.
fields.howto_step_4_des: List the answers that need a staff member before the visit, such as a mismatched member ID, an allergy, or a possible duplicate record. Put one named person against each, add a backup for days off, and choose how each person is told.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Connect your scheduling or practice management system through its API, so a booking starts the intake and a finished one returns as a patient record. Describe the rules from steps 2 to 4 in a prompt, and Emergent builds the app around them.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Load 10 of last week's bookings with made-up patient details and run them through the app. Leave one intake unfinished and upload one blurry card photo on purpose, then confirm that the reminder, the call list, and the review step all arrive.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Go live with one visit type
fields.howto_step_7_des: Start with new patient visits for one provider. Watch the call list and the merge queue for two weeks, move the reminder earlier or later if calls pile up, and add the next visit type once nobody types intakes in by hand.

faq_plan.a: Patient intake automation is software that sends and chases a new patient's intake without a staff member doing each step by hand. The intake goes out when the visit is booked, a reminder follows if it sits unfinished, and the finished answers move into the patient record.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up patient intake automation?
faq_plan.a: Start with one visit type and write its rules in plain English: when the intake goes out, when an unfinished one gets a reminder, and which answers go to which staff member. Emergent's AI automation builder turns that description into a working app with its own database, and a later prompt changes any rule.

faq_plan.q: What should patient intake automation handle first?
faq_plan.a: Automate the step your front desk repeats most. If staff retype paper forms into the scheduling system, start with getting answers into the patient record. If intakes already arrive online, start with reminders for the unfinished ones, because each open intake becomes a phone call the day before.

faq_plan.q: How should patient intake automation handle insurance card photos?
faq_plan.a: Ask for both sides of the card, read the fields from the front, and compare them with what the patient typed. Send a mismatch or a hard-to-read value to one person before the visit. Buyer paperwork in real estate workflow automation follows the same order: upload, read, then check.

faq_plan.q: Which answers should patient intake automation send to staff?
faq_plan.a: Alert only on answers a person must act on before the visit. Good candidates are an allergy that changes the room setup, a missing referral, a member ID that does not match the card, and a minor with no guardian listed. Send each alert to one named person, not a shared inbox.

faq_plan.q: How does patient intake automation get answers into the patient record?
faq_plan.a: Through your scheduling or records system's API, if it offers one. The app sends each finished intake as a new patient record or an update to an existing one. Hold any intake that matches an existing patient on name and date of birth for a person to merge. Apps built with Emergent connect to any system with an API.

faq_plan.q: Can patient intake automation collect signatures on consents?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Place the consents after the last question and capture a typed or drawn signature, saved with the answers from that visit. Use the consent wording your practice already has. Volunteer waivers in nonprofit workflow automation use the same signature step.

faq_plan.q: How do I measure whether patient intake automation is working?
faq_plan.a: Track three numbers each week: the share of intakes finished before the visit, the length of the front desk call list, and how many intakes staff still type in by hand. Compare them with the 4 weeks before go-live. Emergent builds the dashboard with the intake app, on the same database.

faq_plan.q: Does patient intake automation work on a patient's phone?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if the intake is built for a small screen. Show one question per screen, let patients photograph their card instead of typing it, and save progress so they can stop and return. Emergent can build the intake as a conversational flow with one question per screen.

faq_plan.q: Who on staff should own patient intake automation?
faq_plan.a: Give it to the front desk lead, who sees every unfinished intake and every call list. Billing owns the insurance rules and a clinician owns the alert rules, but one person approves every rule change. The same setup suits education workflow automation, where a school's front office owns the absence rules.

plan.angle: Searches for patient intake automation return vendor overviews that list benefits without showing a single rule. This page shows the four places an automated intake should stop and hand work to one named person: unfinished intakes the day before, a member ID that does not match the card photo, an allergy answer before a procedure, and a finished intake that may duplicate an existing patient record. Form design belongs to the Form hub's patient intake page and clinic-wide reminders, referrals and supplies to the healthcare automation page; this page stays on what happens to an intake between booking and the visit.
